evidence: Row 34 verify procedure (references/quality-checks.md §34) is satisfied at source level: every criterion about interaction, waits or live/time-varying behaviour tells the judge to act and wait rather than score first paint. (1) Live board: functional/prompt.md:47 (protocol V) 'In an independent context Mei Lin moves a J1 card and adds a new J1 card. Without reloading or clicking in this page, wait up to 15 seconds (a wait-for call, or snapshots; accept what is present at the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)'; criterion hro_live_board (functional/judge.toml:290). Preservation during that update is exercised in polish hro_pol_live_board (polish/judge.toml:43): open card details, click into note box, type an unfinished note, scroll, other recruiter moves a different card, then check details still open, note value exact, still document.activeElement, scroll not reset, 'typing more appends'. polish/prompt.md:14 adds 'After that action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page until the update has been seen or 15 seconds have passed. Read document.activeElement, field values and scroll offsets with page.evaluate'. This directly mirrors instruction.md:5 ('within fifteen seconds without a reload, and without closing the card I have open, wiping the note I am typing or moving my cursor'). (2) Conversations: polish hro_pol_live_thread (polish/judge.toml:52) types an unfinished reply then waits for Noor's message and checks draft, focus and appending; hro_pol_earlier_place (:61) measures getBoundingClientRect().top before/after loading earlier; functional hro_unread_scrolled_up (functional/judge.toml:344) and protocol U (functional/prompt.md:41: 'wait up to 15 seconds after the other person acts (accept the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)') scroll up, have Noor send, then read place/notice/unread before and after going to it; hro_seen (:353), hro_unread_counts (:335) and hro_msg_exchange (:299) all require observed change within 15 s without reload. (3) Keyboard/focus interactions: hro_msg_compose (:308) Shift+Enter/Enter and focus after send; hro_refused_put_back (:137) reads document.activeElement after a refused move; hro_thread_earlier (:326) repeated clicks with counts. (4) Network/session/time-varying failures: hro_pol_failed_send (polish/judge.toml:70) aborts one send via route handler or setOffline; hro_pol_session_resume (:79) ends the session in a second tab then acts in the first; hro_drafts (functional :371) switch/Board/reload; hro_restart (:407) calls restart_app. (5) Viewport/theme: instruction.md:11 'A clear desktop workspace is what matters. We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout.' visual/prompt.md:14 'Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone layout or theme switching is required.' So resize/toggle exercise is correctly N-A; no criterion grades responsive or themed behaviour, and visual is read-only after the gate but explicitly opens card details and the long conversation rather than judging only first paint. No animation requirement exists. Broken apps tried: (a) live update only on window focus/mousemove/visibilitychange - judges are told not to click/navigate and to wait 15 s, so it fails correctly; (b) polling slower than 15 s - fails per the public 15 s bound; (c) board update that re-renders the details panel/note or resets the board scroll container - caught by hro_pol_live_board's activeElement/value/scroll/append checks; (d) composer re-render on live message at newest - caught by hro_pol_live_thread. Conforming alternatives tried: an app that updates at 14 s is accepted ('first snapshot at or after 15 seconds'); an app that hides refused controls is accepted ('hiding it is optional'). Golden scripted evidence (not a judge run): results/workspace.json results[13] 'live board ... open card, note draft and focus kept' passed with arrival_ms 801; results[14] 'arrival while reading keeps draft, focus and scroll and is not marked read until viewed' passed; results[15] 'seen receipt and unread badges update live' passed; hashes verified. Residual risks (why risk=true): (i) No configured judge run trajectory exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so whether the glm-5.3-flashx judge actually waits/acts as instructed is NOT EXERCISED; the workbook wording 'the judges actually click, wait...' cannot be confirmed from runs. (ii) Golden script does not exercise the polish row exactly as written: workspace.cjs:290-299 moves the SAME card that is open (Di Four), not 'a different card of the same job', and never scrolls or reads a scroll offset before the update, at viewport 1440x900 (workspace.cjs:221) rather than the judge's unconfigured playwright-mcp default; the scroll-preservation half of hro_pol_live_board is unmeasured for the golden. (iii) hro_pol_live_board says 'scroll the page, or the board's scroll container if the page itself does not scroll' with no rule for an app whose page and board both fit without scrolling; a literal judge could fail a conforming compact app. Low likelihood (6 stage columns at minmax(210px) overflow ~1280 px in the golden, styles.css:65) - P3. (iv) The instruction's 'whether I am reading or halfway through a reply, never touch my draft or my cursor' (instruction.md:7): draft preservation is exercised only at the newest message (hro_pol_live_thread), and scrolled-up arrival (hro_unread_scrolled_up) is exercised without a draft; the combined state is not exercised by any judge row (the golden script does test it at workspace.cjs:327-332). This is a coverage-direction note for the coverage rows rather than a still-first-paint defect under row 34.
